name: Captives of Tragedies
source:
"Then let's get started. - shouted the System, which was already being watched by many eyes. One life will be extinguished, while another will be given a "chance". Will you be able to make the right choice, one you won't regret? The game has only just begun."

[From [url=https://captives-of-tragedies.itch.io/captives-of-tragedies]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
““那就开始吧。”系统喊道，此时已经有无数双眼睛注视着，一个生命将被消灭，另一个生命将得到一次“机会”，你能做出正确的选择，一个不会后悔的选择吗？游戏才刚刚开始。”

[来自[url=https://captives-of-tragedies.itch.io/captives-of-tragedies]Itch.io[/url]]
